draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.18, the 103rd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 8th of 25 at RB. He lasted until pick 245, well after his grade rank (103rd): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 106 rushing yards in 2024, 25th of 25 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 17 career games and 7 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 6 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: scrimmage td 8 (77th percentile). Weak spots: fumbles lost 2 (10th percentile), receptions 9 (24th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 873 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, above the norm.
